annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "night" on page 83 ("The Burial of HCE"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history. During this Age of Gods (transition) phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net

annotations.annotation_text: Tavern/jury motif "tap" on page 83 ("The Burial of HCE"): the twelve customers drinking in HCE's Chapelizod pub represent public opinion, the Zodiac, and the Apostles within the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history. During this Age of Gods (transition) phase, they judge, condemn, and demand another round — the Greek chorus of middle-class Dublin gossip.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
Gordon, John. Finnegans Blog (Tavern chapters). https://johngordonfinnegan.weebly.com

annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "hen" on page 83 ("The Burial of HCE"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history. During this Age of Gods (transition) phase, the letter functions simultaneously as archaeological artifact, love note, legal deposition, and the text of Finnegans Wake itself.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Deane, Vincent, et al. The Finnegans Wake Notebooks at Buffalo. https://www.brepols.net
